provenance: Field order, wording and dropdowns read from the owner's screenshots of the PCDA(O) Pune portal create forms, 2026-10-11 (21_ta_da_preclaim_plan.md).
A field marked unverified was not confirmed on the portal; the hint says what is unconfirmed. Plan 22, P3.
kind is the input the app shows (tick, text, date, number, amount, choice), not a claim about the portal's own widget.

options.label: Rule 4(i) TR
options.use_when: An authority listed in Appendix III of the Travel Regulations ordered the move.

options.label: Rule 4(ii) TR
options.use_when: A special sanction covers a move that no other rule or order covers.

options.label: Rule 119 TR
options.use_when: An ordinary temporary duty journey. The portal's usual choice.

options.label: Rule 124 TR (DA not admissible)
options.use_when: A course or examination: conveyance only, so food, hotel and local taxi are nil.

options.label: 177(A) for Home Town
options.use_when: Your yearly trip to your home town or declared place.

options.label: 177(B) for any Station in India
options.use_when: The alternate-year trip to any place in India.

options.label: 177(C) for Officers Serving in Field Concessional Area
options.use_when: The extra yearly trip for a field or CI posting.

options.label: 177(D) for Officers on Study Leave (Self and Family)
options.use_when: You are on study leave and travel with family.

options.label: 177 children of service Personnel Studying in Outstation
options.use_when: A child studying away travels to the family.

options.label: 177(A) visit to J&K, A&N and NE in lieu of Home Town
options.use_when: You swap the home town trip for the North East, J&K or Andaman.

options.label: 177(A)(iii) Sick Leave
options.use_when: A medical board sent you on sick leave to a named place.

options.label: 177(A)(i)(e) Sea Passage
options.use_when: An island resident's sea passage to or from the mainland.

PD.title: Permanent duty

documents.label: A copy of the signal, or the proper posting order

notes: The portal works out the fare and the distance, and sets the advance.

TD.title: Temporary duty

fields.label: TD For Long Duration Course
fields.hint: Unverified against the portal: what the portal does with this tick is not documented. Daily allowance stops after 180 days (Rules 114 and 123).

fields.label: Total Fare
fields.hint: Your own ticket cost; the app does not estimate fares.

fields.label: RMA
fields.hint: Nil without the Rule 40 Note 2 sanction for your own car.

fields.label: Accommodation Charges
fields.hint: A hotel bill is needed; the app only caps your nightly rate at the ceiling.

fields.label: Certificate: no DTS advance taken on the DA part
fields.hint: Tick only if you have not taken an advance on the DA portion of this temporary duty from DTS.

documents.label: The move signal, or the course detail letter

notes: The portal sets the advance and adjusts it at the final claim.

LTC.title: Leave travel (LTC)

fields.label: Children
fields.hint: Unverified against the portal: the largest count its dropdown offers is not known.

fields.label: Dependents
fields.hint: Unverified against the portal: the portal shows ticks with counts, and the exact list was not captured.

fields.label: Visit To
fields.hint: Unverified against the portal: whether this is a typed box or a dropdown was not captured.

fields.label: Year
fields.hint: Unverified against the portal: the portal greys this out and where its value comes from is not known.

fields.label: Nature of Leave
fields.hint: The portal spells Furlough as Forlough.

fields.label: Total Fare
fields.hint: Your own ticket cost; the app does not estimate fares.

documents.label: The undertaking or intimation memo, countersigned by your OC or CO

notes: No amount is worked out for LTC. Pick the rule, then type your fare.
